PDF TensoRF: Tensorial Radiance Fields - ECVA
TensoRF is a novel approach to model and reconstruct radiance fields using tensor decomposition techniques. It achieves fast reconstruction, compact modeling, and photo-realistic rendering for various scenes and viewpoints.
